content.comment_body: I read that [product_name] [version_no] can create secured HTTPS custom web pages, but only supports the latest [product_name] [version_no]. I would like to know how to revert or convert back to standard HTTP as with [product_name] [version_no]. When I try a HTTPS site loaded into [product_name] [version_no], it still works in unsecured HTTP mode, but loads very slowly. I want to convert or adjust it back to HTTP in hopes of speeding up the loading process. Any advice is appreciated.

Hello, check if the option for access control in the tools/transfer section is enabled, and make sure to install the required certificate on your device. Details about certificate installation are available in the [document].

analysis.insight_summary: The user faces slow performance and compatibility problems when running a web project meant for HTTPS from [product_name] [version_no] on older [product_name] [version_no] hardware. The project runs with HTTP but is very slow, and the user asks for a way to switch the site back to HTTP to improve speed. The feedback highlights that newer features like HTTPS are not supported by previous hardware versions, which affects usability and performance.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants to be able to revert a webpage set up for HTTPS back to HTTP to achieve compatibility and faster loading times when using older [product_name] [version_no] hardware.
